answer:
The performer of the song/album **"Tijuana Moods"** is **Charles Mingus**.

Charles Mingus was born in **Nogales, Arizona**, making **Arizona** the state he is from (by birth).

The largest populated city in the state of Arizona is **Phoenix**.

**Phoenix** is home to **Phoenix Raceway** (formerly Phoenix International Raceway), which hosted the annual IndyCar Series round known as the "Grand Prix of Phoenix" or "Dana 500" / "Miller High Life 150" for decades. While many drivers have won at the track, the driver with the most victories (and thus the most associated with winning the race there) is **Al Unser Sr.**, who holds the track's all-time record with **six victories** (in 1969, 1976, 1979, 1980, 1982, and 1985).

Other notable winners include **Tom Sneva** (who won three consecutive times from 1980–1982), **Josef Newgarden** (a recent winner in the modern era), and **Scott Dixon**.

Answer: **Al Unser Sr.** (or simply **Al Unser**)
